journal_lines: High prey. The altitude made everything harder. The return made it worth it.
Mountain quarry. Fast and sure-footed. Matched it.
Chased something up the slope. Came down with more than expected.
The best hunts are the ones that require the climb.
Goat on a ridge that did not have a way down. It found one. So did I.
Air thin as paper, near the summit. Each breath had to be a small one. Caught up anyway.
The mountain made the work harder. The mountain made the catch better.
Stood on a peak with the carry-bag full and the world below. Allowed myself a long look.
